THESE STEP CONTROLS (BLACK BOX ONLY) WERE IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED BY SUBSTITUTING A FUSE (IN PLACE OF A DIODE) ON THE PORCH LAMP CIRCUIT.  THE PORCH LIGHT CIRCUIT EXITS THE CONTROL THROUGH A PURPLE WIRE ON THE POTTED SIDE OF THE CONTROL. summary: If the motor is not properly grounded as instructed, the motor could become energized and cause a shock or electrocution hazard, resulting in injury or death. Units: About 3,200.

title: Candle Holders Recalled by ATICO International USA
summary: The plastic marshmallow can ignite when it is used with a burning candle, presenting a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 530.

title: Stuffed Toys Recalled by Pier 1 Imports
summary: The toys have small parts, which could come loose, posing a possible choking hazard to young children. Units: About 600 stuffed snowmen and 1,300 stuffed reindeer toys.

title: CPSC, LeapFrog Announce Recall to Repair "Alphabet Pal" Educational Pull Toys
summary: The toy has a two-part red plastic connector on the pull string, designed to separate under tension. The plastic pieces can detach from the string when the connector is pulled apart and could pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500,000.

title: CPSC, Playskool Announce Recall of Additional 170,000 Busy Poppin' Pals Toys
summary: Small springs inside these toys can break loose, posing a choking and laceration hazard to young children. Units: 170,000.

title: CPSC, Kent International and Kash 'N Gold Ltd. Announce Recall of Scooters
summary: The Kent scooter handles can unexpectedly come out of the steering column if the clamp holding them in is not tight, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer injuries. title: CPSC, DiaTech USA and Derby USA Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The disc brakes on these bicycles can stick and prevent the brake pads from returning to the proper position, when the brake lever is released. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC and Small Beginnings Inc. Announce Recall of "Pacee" Pacifiers
summary: The pacifiers failed CPSC testing standards. These pacifiers present a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 16,000.

title: CPSC, Sassy Announce Voluntary Recall to Remove Squirting Fish from Bath Toys
summary: The fish's size, texture, shape and easy compressibility make it possible for an infant to compress the toy and place it in his or her mouth. If the toy reaches the back of the mouth and expands, it may block the child's airway. Units: About 370,000.

title: CPSC, Cenex Harvest States Cooperatives Announce Recall to Inspect Propane Gas
summary: The propane may not have contained enough odorant to allow consumers to smell leaking gas, presenting a fire, explosion or thermal burn hazard to consumers. Units: .

title: Christmas Lights Recalled by GEM Stores
summary: The lights have undersized wires that can easily pull out of the plugs and light sockets, posing electric shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: 50,000.

title: Christmas Lights Recalled by Pioneer Paper Co.
summary: The lights have undersized wires that can easily pull out of the plugs and light sockets, posing electric shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: Christmas Lights Recalled by Sun Sun Industries
summary: The lights have undersized wires that can easily pull out of the plugs and light sockets, posing electric shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: 12,000.

title: Christmas Trees Recalled by Walgreen
summary: A color wheel in the tree stand, that is used to light the trees can overheat and catch fire. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, DEWALT® Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall of Battery Chargers
summary: The battery charger can fail to automatically shut off after the battery is fully charged, which can cause the battery to burst, and poses fire, burn and electrical shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 1.7 million.

title: CPSC, Excite Ltd. Announce Recall of Scooters
summary: The front of the folding mechanism, where the steering column meets the base of the scooter, can create a pinch-point. Fingers can be injured while folding or unfolding the scooter. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of "Ranger" Strollers
summary: Lock mechanisms, found on both sides of the stroller, can break and create a pinch-point hazard. Young children can be injured when their fingers, arms or hands are pinched between parts of the locking mechanism. Units: About 25,500.

title: CPSC, White Outdoor Products Co. Announce Recall of Lawn and Garden Tractors
summary: The hood latch on these tractors can damage the fuel tank and cause fuel to leak when the hood is raised and lowered, presenting a fire and explosion hazard. Units: About 9,700.

title: CPSC, L. Powell Co. Announces Recall of Glider Rockers
summary: These glider rockers were manufactured improperly with soft wood and with nails, rather than with wood screws in the gliding joints. The glider rockers can break apart, causing occupants to fall to the floor. Units: About 36,600.
